name: France Excellence Pakistan – Climate Change (2027 call)
provider: Embassy of France in Pakistan / Campus France Pakistan
amount: Tuition, monthly living allowance, return air ticket, visa and Études en France fee waiver, social security, priority CROUS housing, free French classes before departure
deadline: 18 November 2026 (Études en France closing date) — late applications are not accepted
countries: Pakistan — age 28 or under, 4-year Bachelor's with CGPA 3.0/4.0+, graduated within the last 2 years
description: Five climate-related Master's programmes for Pakistani students: Process & Bioprocess Engineering (IMT Atlantique, Nantes), Biorefinery & Biomaterials (Grenoble INP-Pagora), MAFEN agriculture & food (Avignon), One-Health Emerge (ONIRIS) and International Economics (Lille). Apply through Études en France; for IMT Atlantique and Pagora you must ALSO apply on the school's own platform.
tips: Selection looks at grades, a consistent statement of purpose and English. A link between your Pakistani university and the French one helps. Women and applicants from all provinces are encouraged.

name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (via Campus France)
amount: Monthly allowance (about €1,200 for Master's, about €1,700 for PhD in recent rounds), travel, health insurance, cultural activities
deadline: French universities submit nominations in early January 2027 — apply to your university first (internal deadlines often Nov–Dec)
description: France's flagship scholarship. You don't apply directly: you apply to a French institution, and the institution nominates you. Strongest fields: engineering, law, economics, management, political science.
tips: Email the international office of each target university in October and ask for their internal Eiffel deadline.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Scholarships
amount: €1,400 per month, tuition, travel and installation costs
deadline: Varies by programme — most close between October and February
description: Two-year Master's taught in English in two or more European countries, many with a French partner. Each programme runs its own selection. Erasmus Mundus scholars are exempt from the Études en France fee.
tips: Use the official catalogue and filter by France. You can apply to up to three programmes per year.

name: Campus Bourses — scholarship search engine
amount: Scholarships from the French government, regions, universities and companies
deadline: Each scholarship has its own deadline
description: The official database of scholarships for studying in France. Filter by nationality, level and field to see what you can apply for.
tips: Search with your own nationality selected — results change a lot by country.

name: SMARTS-UP Scholarship
deadline: Yearly call, usually winter — check the portal
description: Mobility scholarship for international students admitted to a Master's in one of Université Paris Cité's Graduate Schools. No application fee and no IELTS needed for the scholarship itself.
tips: Apply to the Master's first; the scholarship is linked to your Graduate School.

name: Ampère Scholarships of Excellence
description: For excellent international students admitted to a Master's at ENS de Lyon, in sciences or humanities. No application fee.
tips: A strong academic record and a research-oriented project matter most.

name: PSL PhD Track Grants
amount: €10,000 per year during the Master's years, then a funded doctoral contract
description: Five-year integrated Master's + PhD tracks at PSL for students aiming at research careers.
tips: Contact a potential supervisor in the PSL lab you're interested in before applying.

name: ENS-PSL Computer Science Master's Grants
amount: Grants for international students in the CS Master's
description: Scholarships offered by the ENS Computer Science department to top international Master's applicants.
tips: Strong maths and theoretical CS background expected.

name: Université Paris-Saclay International Master's Scholarships
amount: Monthly stipend for the Master's year(s), plus travel support
deadline: Linked to the Master's application window (winter–spring)
description: Excellence scholarships for strong international applicants to Paris-Saclay Master's programmes.
tips: Tick the scholarship option when applying to the Master's — there is often no separate form.

name: Université Grenoble Alpes Master's Scholarships
deadline: Usually winter–spring, depending on the programme
description: Excellence scholarships for international students admitted to eligible UGA Master's programmes, including many taught in English.
tips: Check each Master's page for its scholarship section.

name: Émile Boutmy Scholarship
amount: Tuition reduction and/or a yearly grant
deadline: Same as the Sciences Po admission deadline
description: Sciences Po's main scholarship for high-achieving non-EU students admitted to its Bachelor's or Master's programmes.
tips: Many Sciences Po Master's programmes are fully in English.

name: Institut Polytechnique de Paris Master's Scholarships
deadline: Linked to the Master's application rounds
description: Scholarships for international students in IP Paris and École Polytechnique Master's programmes, most taught in English.
tips: Apply in the earliest round — more funding is available.

name: AgroParisTech Erasmus Mundus Master's (FIPDes, Bioceb, GloFor)
amount: About €1,000+ per month for 24 months plus installation costs (Erasmus Mundus rates)
description: Erasmus Mundus Master's in food innovation (FIPDes), bioeconomy (Bioceb) and global forestry (GloFor), with AgroParisTech as a partner.
tips: Check each programme website for the current call.

name: Mathematics & Its Interactions Master's Scholarship
description: Scholarships for the second year of the Mathematics Master's in Nice.
tips: For students with a strong maths background.

name: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Networks
amount: Full PhD salary with social security, mobility and family allowances
description: Paid PhD positions in European research networks, many in French labs. You apply to a specific open position.
tips: Search EURAXESS for 'MSCA' and filter by France.

name: PHC Peridot — France–Pakistan research mobility
provider: French Embassy / Campus France & HEC Pakistan
amount: Travel and living allowances for researchers moving between France and Pakistan (2–3 year projects)
deadline: 13th call closed 30 September 2026 — next call usually opens in July
description: Funds research exchanges between a French team and a Pakistani team. Priority areas in the 13th call: health sciences, sustainable energy, agriculture & food security, economics of climate change. PhD students and postdocs are encouraged.
tips: Both teams must submit — the French team to Campus France and the Pakistani team to HEC.

name: HEC Pakistan Overseas Scholarships
amount: Tuition, living allowance, travel (service bond applies)
description: HEC runs overseas Master's and PhD scholarship schemes; some phases include France as a destination.
tips: Read the bond conditions carefully before applying.

name: Erasmus+ exchange mobility
amount: Monthly grant for a semester or year in France
countries: Students of universities with an Erasmus+ agreement with a French institution
description: If your Pakistani university has an Erasmus+ partnership with a French university, you can spend a semester there with a grant.
tips: Ask your university's international office which French partners they have.

name: University tuition fee waivers
amount: Full or partial waiver of the higher non-EU fees
description: Public universities can exempt only a share of international students from the higher fees (30% in 2026/27, falling in later years), so waivers are harder to get than before.
tips: Ask the international office about the waiver as soon as you receive your admission.
